steps.title: Analyze Manifest Merger Issues
steps.description: Inspect the AndroidManifest.xml and identify missing key attributes during compilation.

steps.title: Fix Manifest Namespace and Package
steps.description: Add package attribute to the manifest tag and use relative class references to satisfy manifest merger requirements.

steps.title: Remove Forbidden Third-Party Dependencies
steps.description: Remove org.nanohttpd:nanohttpd from build.gradle to ensure full compliance with internal native library rules.

steps.title: Verify Database Integration Helper
steps.description: Ensure SQLite tables, helper class creation scripts, and task query loaders are structured properly.

steps.title: Check Canvas Custom View Renderer
steps.description: Validate the AnalyticsView painting logic, grid metrics, and background thread redraws.

steps.title: Audit Dashboard and Clock Thread
steps.description: Verify the uptime clock thread state and database counts loader in MainActivity.

steps.title: Validate Task Activity Controls
steps.description: Confirm the adapter bindings, input validators, and task database clear operations function flawlessly.

steps.title: Inspect Note Document Workspaces
steps.description: Verify the notepad rich editor, content auto-save procedures, and list selection logs.

steps.title: Verify Calculator Operations and Converters
steps.description: Check the evaluation stack, metric adapters, and custom conversion functions.

steps.title: Building OmniControl Suite
steps.description: Compile and assemble the application to generate a clean, warning-free debug APK.
